text:
Nora (CS): Marigold just escalated — embeddings p99 on their dedicated pool spiked to ~2.4s for the last 3 hours. They're calling this an SLA risk and want a mitigation plan by EOD. Can eng triage and propose an immediate workaround? :warning:
Leah (PM): Thanks Nora. Quick ask: can we outline milestones (triage -> hotfix -> canary -> rollout) and clear owners? Customer expects updates every 2 hours.
Sam (Eng): I'm on it. Initial ask: logs + sample request ids. Nora, can you drop a few request IDs and the pool id?
Nora (CS): pool id: dedicated-marigold-3, sample ids: req_8f7c, req_8fb2, req_8fe1. Link to the customer's dashboard: https://console.redwood/marigold/requests (customer-only view)
Alia (Eng-SRE): Observability shows consistent tail latency correlated with KV cache misses and increased batch sizes during their traffic spike. See quick graph: https://telemetry.redwood/s/abc123/embed-p99. My suggestion: short-term traffic steering to hosted fallback + enable prefix/KV caching for that pool.
Sam (Eng): Agreed. Plan I can execute: 1) Triage batching path and KV cache behavior (30m) 2) Draft hotfix to reduce max batch window to 20ms for marigold pool (PR + smoke) (2h) 3) Canary deploy (30m) 4) Full rollout if green. Need code review from @Mike and infra approval from @Alia.
Mike (EngMgr): I can review the PR within 90m. Sam, please tag me and include a short perf test. If patch is low risk we can canary tonight.
Sam (Eng): Creating PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/4123. Title: "dedicated: reduce batch window for customer-specific p99 mitigation". CC @Mike @Alia.
Leah (PM): Milestone timeline proposal (customer-facing):
- Triage & owner confirmation: +30m (1715433900)
- Hotfix PR open & CI: +2h (1715435700)
- Canary deploy (10% traffic): +2.5h (1715436300)
- Full rollout if canary ok: +6h (1715450000)
Please confirm owners and if these are realistic.
Alia (Eng-SRE): Owners ack: triage/monitoring: Alia; runtime change & PR: Sam; review/approval: Mike; customer comms: Nora/Leah. I can also push a temporary routing rule to steer 10% to hosted fallback.
Sam (Eng): Workaround config (can apply via feature flag API):
```json
PATCH /feature-flags/traffic-route
{
  "selector": "customer:marigold",
  "routes": [
    {"target": "dedicated-marigold-3", "weight": 90},
    {"target": "hosted-raven2-embeddings", "weight": 10}
  ]
}
```
Sam (Eng): I'll apply the 10% fallback now after @Alia gives the green light. This buys us time while I work on the batching patch.
Alia (Eng-SRE): Green — applying fallback route now. Watch logs for increased error or skew.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: PR #4123 -> canary cluster at 1715436300. Status: queued.
Sam (Eng): Quick heads-up on CR: small change in batching loop + unit test. Mike, ping when you can review (small code path).
Mike (EngMgr): Reviewing now. Left a small comment on the batch_timer logic re: edge case when seq_len > 1024. Sam, add a unit test for that case and I'll unblock.
Sam (Eng): Added test & pushed (force-push). PR updated.
deploy-bot: PR #4123 CI passed. Canary deploy starting at 1715436300.
oncall-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0318-58 — Marigold embeddings latency. Oncall: Alia.
Alia (Eng-SRE): Canary metrics look promising — p99 dropped from 2.4s -> 0.9s for canary subset. Monitoring for 20 minutes more.
Leah (PM): Customer update draft: "We've identified a batching-related regression impacting tail latency on dedicated pools. We've rolled a canary fix and routed 10% traffic to hosted fallback. We'll update again at +2h with rollout status." Approve?
Nora (CS): Approved. I'll send now and include the milestone ETA.
Sam (Eng): If canary stays green, I'm scheduling full rollout window at 1715450000 (per Leah timeline). If anything flares, we'll rollback and keep the 10% fallback.
Mike (EngMgr): Good plan. Keep pings here every 30m until we close.
Leah (PM): Thanks team — owners and milestones confirmed. Sam/Alia/Mike/Nora — please follow the timeline and tag this thread on each milestone update. :thumbsup:
Nora (CS): Sending initial update to customer now.
Sam (Eng): Next status ping in 30m with triage findings.
Alia (Eng-SRE): I'll keep monitoring dashboards and alert on any error spikes.
(End of thread)
